000.$description: Used by: dark surface.primary (Sampled), dark text.primary (Sampled (text)), light bg.page (Sampled), light surface.card (Sampled).

250.$description: Used by: light border.cardDivider (Sampled), light border.divider (Sampled).

550.$description: Used by: dark text.tab (Sampled (text)), light text.tab (Sampled (text)).

1250.$description: Used by: dark bg.grouped (Sampled), dark bg.page (Sampled).

card.$description: Grouped cards and the Push Notifications banner: 25.6pt on Settings and 25.6pt on the banner, both themes. Plus or minus 2 pt.

textArea.$description: Multi-line fields (Bio on Edit Profile): 23.9pt in both themes.

control.$description: Tiles that hold a control: the event page's Register, Contact and More buttons (11.9pt) and the Start and End group on Create Event (11.9pt over the cover tint).

thumb.$description: Event cover thumbnails (8.5pt on a flat cover) and calendar tiles (8.5pt).

icon.$description: Coloured icon tiles in Settings rows: 6.8pt dark, 5.1pt light.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the tab bar and its selected pill, glass nav buttons, the search field, filter chips, outlined category chips, the segmented control, Invited badges, price and status pills, the Subscribe and Confirm buttons, single-line fields (Name), the composer, message bubbles, the send button and switches.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Gap between a host line and the title under it, and between stacked meta lines.

sm.$description: Gap between filter chips and between category chips.

md.$description: Gap between an event thumbnail and its text: the thumbnail ends at x 216 px and the host line starts at x 240 px in 01.

lg.$description: Inner padding of grouped cards: Settings row text starts 16 pt inside the card (x 88 px, card edge at 56 px in 23).

xl.$description: Screen margin: titles, list rows, cards and chips start 20 pt from the screen edge (x 56 px, screen edge at 16 px, in every capture).

cardGap.$description: Between two grouped cards with no header: the first Settings card ends at y 524 px and the next starts at 572 px in 23 (edges in rows.settings).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of titles, rows, cards and chips.

row.$description: Grouped row (Settings, Notifications), divider to divider: dividers at 830 and 928 px in 25, 669 px and the card's end at 766 px in 23.

height.$description: Floating glass tab bar (Home, Discover, Chat).

width.$description: Tab bar width, centred, inset from the screen edges.

selected.$description: Width of the selected tab's pill inside the bar.

navButton.$description: Round glass back, share, search and more buttons: 44pt wide and 45pt tall, the glass rim's soft edge included. Two actions share one 88pt capsule on tab roots (+ and the bell).

searchField.$description: Search field (glass capsule) beside the back button.

chip.$description: Glass filter chip height ('Near you' is 101pt wide), glass rim included.

categoryChip.$description: Outlined category chip height (Family, Tech): 40.5pt dark, 40pt light, outline included.

height.$description: Segmented control (Upcoming, Past): 49pt including the glass rim's soft edge; 47 pt from the pixel runs in 31. 212pt wide with the rim.

pill.$description: The selected segment's pill: 41pt tall with its edge, 80.5pt wide; 40 pt (y 175 to 254 px) inside the edge.

thumb.$description: Square event cover thumbnail in a list row: 80pt dark, 81pt light.

badge.$description: 'Invited' badge straddling a thumbnail's lower edge (50x18pt).

pill.$description: Price and status pills (US$15 45x17pt; Sold Out 18.5pt with its soft edge).

button.$description: Full-width capsule button (Confirm): 335x47pt dark, 336x43pt light; the white fill's anti-aliasing reads taller on dark.

buttonCompact.$description: Inline capsule button (Subscribe): 96pt wide, 34.5pt tall dark, 35.5pt light.

actionTile.$description: Event page action tile, icon over label (Register 112x53pt; Contact and More the same).

send.$description: Round send button inside the composer: 28x28pt.

header.$description: Account avatar at the top left of a tab root: 44pt dark, 46pt light.

calendarTile.$description: Square calendar tile in Your Calendars: 81pt with its anti-aliased edge.

meta.$description: Line icons before event meta lines (clock, pin) and in menus.

settingsIcon.$description: Coloured icon tile at the start of a Settings row.

countBadge.$description: Red unread count on a tab: 19.5x19pt.

dot.$description: Red unread dot in a chat row: 8x7.5pt.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, rows, the tab bar and full buttons are 44 pt or more. Filter chips (34 pt), the composer (42 pt), the send button (28 pt) and the switch are smaller.

hairline.$description: Dividers between event rows and between card rows: one device pixel at 2x.

outline.$description: Outlined category chips: a two-pixel anti-aliased edge (y 1216 to 1218 px in 09).

selected.$description: The selected Colour Scheme card's outline: three pixels with anti-aliasing (y 437 to 439 px in 24).

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are close to the iOS system face; use the platform font.

regular.$description: Meta lines, host lines, descriptions, Settings rows. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Event row titles, badge and pill labels, tab labels, action tile labels. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav titles, section titles, date sections, chat row titles, button labels. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: Tab root titles, category and event page titles, the About Event opening, the Event Name placeholder. Judged by stroke width.

title1.$description: Category and calendar page titles (Family, [SF] HackerSquad). Cap-height readings: 28pt.

title2.$description: Tab root titles beside the avatar (Discover, Chat) and the event page title. Cap-height readings: 22pt.

aboutHeading.$description: The bold opening line of About Event. Cap-height readings: 20pt.

placeholderLarge.$description: The Event Name field on Create Event, placeholder and typed text. Cap-height readings: 21pt.

title3.$description: Section titles with a chevron (Your Events, Picked for You, Browse by Category). Cap-height readings: 19pt.

headline.$description: Event row titles, up to two lines. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

navTitle.$description: Nav titles (Notifications, Settings), date sections ('Today'), chat row titles. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Settings rows, grouped section headers (grey), menu items. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

callout.$description: Event meta lines (time, place), category descriptions, notifications (on a 21px line). Cap-height readings: 15pt.

subhead.$description: Host lines above an event title ('Emergent', 'TEDxSingapore'). Cap-height readings: 12pt.

caption.$description: Badge labels ('Invited'), action tile labels ('Register'), thread timestamps and footnotes under cards. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

pill.$description: Price and status pill labels (US$15, Sold Out, Near Capacity). Cap-height readings: 11pt.

notTokenised: Cover tint: event pages and the Create Event sheet take their background, buttons and fields from the cover image in both themes; color.coverExample holds one cover's readings, not fixed values
iOS 26 glass (tab bar, nav buttons, search field, filter chips, segmented control, menus, the Date Range sheet, the composer): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: none drawn; separation comes from the page and card fills and the glass material
Line heights of one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: Full-bleed pages: Home, Discover, Chat, search, a category or calendar page, Your Events, Notifications.

grouped.$description: Page behind grouped cards: Settings and its pushed pages (Notifications, Account, Edit Profile). Black in dark, a pale grey in light.

scrim.$description: Behind the Date Range sheet: black at 0.24, from the search field reading #FDFDFD undimmed (12) and #C0C0C0 under the sheet (14).

card.$description: Grouped cards, the Push Notifications banner (#FFFFFF) and fields on Edit Profile (#FFFFFF).

bubble.$description: Message bubbles in a chat thread.

glass.$description: Glass controls over an empty page: the tab bar; nav buttons read #F9F9FB, the search field #FDFDFD, filter chips #F9F9F9, the composer #F9F9F9. The material tints with what is behind it.

selected.$description: The selected pill inside glass: the current tab, the selected segment (#E7E7E7). Darker than the glass in both themes.

menu.$description: Pull-down and pop-up menus (glass; pop-ups read #FDFDFD). The reading picks up the page behind.

sheet.$description: The Date Range sheet (glass over the dimmed search page). The average of a small box (channel spread 4): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

primary.$description: The theme's ink: the Confirm button, the enabled Create Event check. White in dark, near-black in light. The box's dominant colour covers 88% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

divider.$description: Hairline between event rows, inset to the row text.

cardDivider.$description: Hairline between rows inside a grouped card, inset to the row text.

chip.$description: Outline of category chips (Family, Tech): the only outlined control.

control.$description: Outline of an unselected option card (Colour Scheme).

selected.$description: Outline of the selected option card: the theme's ink.

primary.$description: Titles, event row titles, Settings rows; nav titles read #000000.

secondary.$description: Meta lines (time, place), host lines (#727272), descriptions.

tertiary.$description: The weekday after a date section ('/ Saturday'), grouped section headers (#9C9C9E), chat row dates (#A1A1A1).

disabled.$description: Past days in the Date Range calendar, read over the glass sheet.

link.$description: Text links ('Open Settings'); 'Now' in the Date Range sheet reads #136AEA.

onAccent.$description: Label on the purple Subscribe button and the blue send button's arrow.

tabSelected.$description: Selected tab label and icon: the ink, not a brand colour.

fg.$description: Luma's purple as text: 'Invited' badge labels.

subtle.$description: 'Invited' badge fill. The average of a small box (channel spread 3): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

emphasis.$description: The Subscribe button: a lighter, warmer purple than the badge text. The box's dominant colour covers 58% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

tile.$description: The category icon disc (Family) and avatar role dots in Notifications. The average of a small box (channel spread 2): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused field: the only focus indicator (no ring). A two-pixel column, so the share is low; it is the ink, anti-aliased. The box's dominant colour covers 22% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

subtle.$description: Price pill fill. The average of a small box (channel spread 5): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

fg.$description: 'Sold Out' pill label; destructive rows read #ED2932 (Delete Account) and destructive menu items #FD3639 (Unfollow, Report Event).

subtle.$description: 'Sold Out' pill fill. The average of a small box (channel spread 3): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

emphasis.$description: Unread count on the Chat tab and the unread dot in a chat row (#EE2B32). The average of a small box (channel spread 1): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

subtle.$description: 'Near Capacity' pill fill. The average of a small box (channel spread 3): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.
'Waitlist Open' pill fill. The average of a small box (channel spread 5): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

emphasis.$description: The send button in the composer, once there is text. The average of a small box (channel spread 5): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

off.$description: Switch off track, read over the Create Event sheet, so it carries the cover tint (orange cover in dark, purple in light). No switch was captured on a plain page. The average of a small box (channel spread 2): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

eventPage.$description: One event page's background (the TEDxSingapore cover). The app derives it from each cover; do not use it as a fixed value. The average of a small box (channel spread 5): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

eventButton.$description: Contact and More tiles on that event page: a lighter wash of the same tint. The average of a small box (channel spread 2): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

createPage.$description: The Create Event sheet with a random cover (orange in dark, purple in light). The app derives it from the cover. The average of a small box (channel spread 0): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

createField.$description: Fields on that sheet: a lighter wash of the same tint. The average of a small box (channel spread 3): the mirroring stream leaves a few levels of noise on small tinted fills, so no one pixel is exact.

bg.$description: Nav buttons, filter chips, the Following button.

danger.$description: Danger: red labels, destructive rows and menu items.

notTokenised: Disabled buttons: the Create Event check is a faint glass circle before a name is typed (19) and the ink once one is (20); read from the screenshots, not tokenised
Map tiles, cover art, calendar avatars and app icons: content, not tokens
